= FAQ (General) =

== Is PariDroid open source? ==

Yes, both PariDroid and PARI/GP are available for free under the terms of the GNU Public License (version 3).

== Do I need root to use PariDroid? ==

No, you *do not* need to root your phone to use PariDroid.

PariDroid is a GUI application which derives most of its functionality from `libpari` and is consistent with the intended uses of the Android NDK.

== Do I need root to run the cross-compiled `gp` binary on Android? ==

Yes, you *do* need to root your phone and have busybox installed to use either (static or dynamic) of the native cross-compiled `gp` binary. 

This is a consequence of Android's security/permission features.

In general, running cross-compiled native binaries is not (officially) supported on Android and comes with many caveats. Dalvik (Android's implementation of the JVM) can kill any "wild" processes (i.e., not running under an application's uid) at any time for no reason, although this has never happened with the gp binary on Android.

That said, there are certain advantages to using the native `gp` binary (especially since the GUI is in such an early stage of development).

== Does PariDroid provide all of the same functionality as GP? ==

No.

Most of the mathematical functions should work in an identical way, but some of the more advanced GP programming features are not available.

It would be nice to have more PariDroid provide more `gp`-like functionality than it currently does, but `gp` can do some things are simply not possible to implement in PariDroid (at the moment).

The `system("command")` function is an example of a feature which works in the native ARM-Android `gp` binary but does not work through PariDroid.  

For the purposes of simply doing mathematical calculations, PariDroid should provide sufficient functionality to be useful in most cases. 

== Is it possible to run a GP script through PariDroid? ==

Not yet.

= FAQ (Development) =

== How do I cross-compile PARI/GP from scratch? ==

See [https://code.google.com/p/paridroid/wiki/BuildingPariForAndroid BuildingPariForAndroid].

== I just downloaded the source code for PariDroid. How do I build it? ==

The build process for PariDroid is not as simple as it should be, but since there is currently only one developer working on the project, simplifying the build environment has not been a high priority.

*TODO:*
  * Write a GNU Makefile to automate the build process.
  * Write documentation explaining how to build PariDroid from source.

== What development environment do you use to write/build PariDroid? ==

These are the only tool/system configurations that have been used to successfully build PariDroid.

  * *Text Editor:* GNU Emacs.
  * *Operating System:* Ubuntu GNU/Linux (version 10.10/11.04, arch i686/AMD64)
  * *SDK Version:* Android SDK-r12.
  * *NDK Version:* Android NDK-r6b.
  * *Android API Level:* 8 (Android 2.2)
  * *Java JDK Version:* `sun-java6-jdk`.

Note: There is currently no way for me to give support for building under Windows or with the Eclipse IDE. 

== How can I access the SDK/NDK tools more effectively? ==

If you are using `bash`, add the following aliases to `~/.bashrc` and start a new terminal session:

{{{
export NDK='' # Put the path to the root of your NDK directory here.
export SDK='' # Put the path to the root of your SDK directory here. 
export JAVA_HOME='/usr/lib/jvm/java-6-sun' # Change this if necessary.

alias ndk_build='$NDK/ndk-build -B V=1'
alias ndk_clean='$NDK/ndk-build clean'

alias android='$SDK/tools/android'
alias emulator='$SDK/tools/emulator'
alias mksdcard='$SDK/tools/mksdcard'
alias adb='$SDK/platform-tools/adb'
}}}

= Support =

== I have a question about PariDroid, ==

The best place to ask questions is on the [https://groups.google.com/forum/?hl=en#!forum/paridroid PariDroid mailing list].

You can also e-mail the project maintainers directly, but it is better to post to the mailing list for the sake of making PariDroid development as open as possible. 

== I would like to file a bug report or feature request. ==

You can file a bug report or feature request here: [https://code.google.com/p/paridroid/issues/entry]

== I would like to contribute to PariDroid ==

Great! Here is what you should do.

  # Download the Android SDK/NDK, the source code for PARI/GP and build PariDroid on your own.
  # Join the [https://groups.google.com/forum/?hl=en#!forum/paridroid PariDroid mailing list] and introduce yourself.
  # Submit a patch (bug fix, new feature) to the mailing list and then you will (most likely) be given commit access to the repository.
  # Write more code (and even more documentation)!
